meta.label: Property rent by comune (2025H2)
meta.source: Agenzia delle Entrate — Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare (OMI)
meta.methodNote: Residential rent, €/m² per month, averaged across that comune's own OMI zones. Transaction-range midpoints for "Abitazioni civili" in normal condition, OMI semester 2025H2. Comuni absent from the OMI file are absent here, never zero-filled.
